A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study of epistemic-marker confidence. Inspection of all pages, including Appendices A–C and rendered figures, supports reliable comparison. Appendix content is retained despite changed pagination.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations, calibration measurements, filtering-threshold analyses, and distribution-shift results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the main model comparisons and the MATH-500/GSM8K analysis in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The marker-confidence computation and extraction procedure are unchanged, including self-extraction through few-shot prompting and the GPT-4o-mini fallback. Added citations in Appendix B.3 do not introduce a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use BoolQ, StrategyQA, GSM8K, MMLU, CSQA, MedMCQA, and CaseHOLD, plus MATH-500 in Appendix C. The represented tasks, domains, and distribution-shift scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Directly elicited numerical confidence remains the baseline. Tables 1–2 retain the same seven model variants, and Figure 4 retains the same base-versus-instruction-tuned model comparisons.

E3.justification: Table 3's splits and sample counts, preprocessing, prompts, seven evaluation metrics, temperature of 0.5, and marker-filtering thresholds are unchanged. The appendix reflow does not introduce or revise an experimental setting.

E4.justification: Both retain the threshold-50/100 sensitivity analysis, accuracy–marker-consistency correlations, five-prompt-permutation check, base-versus-instruction-tuned analysis, and Appendix C's diversity and difficulty analyses.

E5.justification: Appendix B.4.2 and Table 6 retain the same uncertainty discussion and approximate confidence intervals: 23%, 10%, and 5% for thresholds 10, 50, and 200. No repeated-run, seed, or significance-reporting changes appear.

E6.justification: All reported result entries and values in Tables 1–2 and 7–8 match, as do Figures 2–4. For example, Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct retains I-AvgECE 4.78 and C-AvgECE 10.40; Appendix C retains MRC values 0.38 and 0.26 for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3.

T1.justification: Section 3.1's marker-confidence definition and Appendix B.4.1's metric definitions and formulas are mathematically unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims: marker confidence is relatively stable within distributions but unreliable across distributions, with stronger models showing greater consistency.

C2.justification: The marker-preference explanation and interpretations concerning distribution diversity and difficulty remain unchanged. The limitations concerning brief QA responses, English-only markers, linguistic context, and long-form communication are also retained.

D1.justification: The abstract's actual code-link destination changes from HKUST-KnowComp/MarCon to HKUST-KnowComp/MarConf. Other implementation and access details remain unchanged. The PDFs establish the revised address, but not whether either destination is accessible.

R1.justification: Appendix A adds Zong et al. (2025) and Guo et al. (2025), while dropping Lin et al. (2024) and Ma et al. (2023). Appendix B adds two Wang et al. (2025) citations; Appendix C replaces six Wang references with Liu et al. (2025, 2026). These localized citation changes leave the surrounding positioning argument intact.

P1.justification: Text edits are limited to citation callouts, the repository address, and the arXiv version/date stamp. The title, authors, explanatory prose, section hierarchy, and narrative order are retained.

P2.justification: Appendix material is reflowed: Figure 4 moves from the right to the left column, and several tables move to earlier pages. All four figures and eight tables are retained, with unchanged substantive displays, axes, legends, and captions.

improvement.justification: Both versions provide the same scientific argument, empirical evidence, implementation detail, and limitations. Localized citation substitutions and appendix reflow leave their clarity and evidential support essentially equivalent. The changed repository address alone does not establish improved access or reproducibility from the supplied PDFs.
